definitions.gloss: feeding animals; giving food to animals or fish
definitions.explanation: The act of feeding animals, whether pets, livestock, or wild animals. Often seen on signs prohibiting feeding.

examples.japanese: {餌|えさ}やり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{金魚|きんぎょ}→金魚：00233_kingyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餌|えさ}やり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I feed the goldfish every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}→来場者：19023_raijousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}できる→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧{餌|えさ}やり⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: At the zoo, the feeding experience that visitors can participate in is popular.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧ (feed; bait) and ⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (giving). Very commonly seen on signs in parks, zoos, and public areas where feeding wild animals is restricted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {餌|えさ}やり⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no feeding (sign)
- {餌|えさ}やり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feed (animals)
- {餌|えさ}やり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: feeding time
- {餌|えさ}やり⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: feeding experience (at a zoo or farm)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {給餌|きゅうじ}: feeding — formal/technical term used in agriculture and animal husbandry
- ⟦{餌付|えづ}け→餌付け：19231_ezuke⟧: taming animals with food; habituating wild animals to being fed — often has a negative connotation when done to wild animals

USAGE:
The phrase {餌|えさ}やり⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no feeding) is one of the most common signs in Japanese parks and tourist areas, especially around deer, pigeons, and stray cats.
